text: Systemic risks have risen relative to the last Article IV consultation, but the banking sector remains resilient and macroprudential policy settings remain appropriate. Stage 3 and stage 2 loans declined to 1.4 and 7.7 percent in 2025Q4, the CCyB rate is maintained at 1.5 percent, and non-bank financial sector assets exceeded €7 trillion in 2025 (over 20 times the estimated GNI*). Staff judge that non-bank leverage and liquidity mismatches could amplify adverse shocks, recommending that the CBI continue stress tests, adjust macroprudential settings as warranted, and maintain its leadership role in developing an NBFI macroprudential framework.
